utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still looking for a few more hands for the repair drive. I can point you to who’s organizing it if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Who’s organizing it, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s Mara and Ben from the block committee, right over on Alder Street.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive. Tell me what’s needed and I’ll repeat the plan along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think it was supposed to be the usual stuff, but I might be missing a piece.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can repeat it along. Just tell me the piece you’re missing, and I’ll keep the plan straight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look today. Just tell me where to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m by the blue house on Maple, near the broken fence.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m on my way to the blue house now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive's coming up. What still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly the porch light and the loose fence gate. I’ve got a list if you want the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please. I can help with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to know what time the repair drive is and whether I need to work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check the exact time and make sure it fits around school pickup, then I’ll send it over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, send it over when you have the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can swing by after breakfast, but I need the time and the address to keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry, I should have said: after breakfast at 123 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, that works for me. I’ll see you after breakfast at 123 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Pia, if you’re in, I can put your name down for the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I need to know the timing and what the drive actually involves before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — I can tell you the timing and what it involves before you decide.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is moving along, but I only got that second-hand. Did you want the latest from your side?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I have the latest: the repair drive is on track, and we’re still collecting a few final needs from the block. I can send you the current list if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please send the current list and I’ll keep it moving on my side.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we start, can you confirm what’s included in the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It covers the usual small fixes: tools, hardware, and a quick help bench for basic repairs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so it includes tools, hardware, and the help bench. Do I need to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with that, but I need to keep this one small.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the small stuff off your hands, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help. Just the light stuff, if you don’t mind.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a few screwdrivers if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That'd help a lot. Can you also bring any extra bits, like spare bits or a flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring spare bits and a flashlight too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to help; where’s the repair drive headed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: To the repair shop on Elm, just down the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Elm’s right nearby, then. I’ll head over now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a wrench and a ladder if the repair drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot, Gus. Bring them by and we’ll see what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring them over now and we can start with whatever’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need the pickup times and who’s bringing the tools before we start.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm the pickup times and who’s bringing the tools, then we can start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I need the pickup times and the tool crew confirmed before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can swing by after lunch and help however I can. What still needs attention for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, then the biggest things are the loose steps by the back door and the sign stack that needs rehanging. If you can tackle one of those after lunch, I’ll point you to the rest.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll take the loose steps after lunch, then you can point me at the sign stack if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few extra extension cords and work gloves if the drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late, but I can help load them in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set these by the curb and we can get them loaded fast.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s been picking up nicely, and folks are still dropping off supplies this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s good to hear. I can stop by after school pickup if they still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like they could use you after pickup, especially for the heavier stuff. I’ll tell you, those donations keep coming in too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What’s the main thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo. The biggest thing is helping organize the repair drive list and a couple of volunteers for pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can do that. I’ll help organize the list and line up a couple volunteers for pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. What’s the first thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can start with the drive label and the file names. That’ll tell me if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, send me the drive label and file names, and I’ll check what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by the repair drive this afternoon, Nell. I can pass the word fast and make sure you get a slot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll come by this afternoon if I can get a slot. Thanks for passing it on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll save you a spot and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check where the repair drive is headed. Do you have the address or the street name?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don't have it handy, but I can check the address book and tell you straight away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No rush, just let me know when you’ve got the address.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, so I’ll check the schedule before I say the start time. You can bring any clean rags, tape, and a screwdriver if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring those, and let me know as soon as you have the start time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along, but I haven't caught the latest details yet. If you need a hand, I can check in while I'm out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think it's coming along, but I keep losing track of the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Maybe I should swing by and ask around while I'm out. If I hear the latest, I'll bring it back to you.
